name: AMIRI

prices.note: Collections mens-pants and mens-denim (USD), 76 available regular-price pants and jeans: Amiri Track Pant $650 to All Over Crystal MX1 Jean $4,490; Baggy Jean $750, Vintage Cut Leather Pant $2,390. The MX1 jean has its own collection (mens-denim-mx1).

notes: US shipping: complimentary 3-5 day standard, $20 express, $30 rush; international orders by DHL Express (https://amiri.com/policies/shipping-policy).
Returns: within 10 days of delivery, complimentary domestic return shipping, one exchange shipment paid (https://amiri.com/policies/refund-policy).
About: Mike Amiri established AMIRI in 2014 in his hometown of L.A. (https://amiri.com/pages/about).
Tailoring and some pants also come in EU 44–58 (mens-pants feed).
